text:
oncall-bot: Pager duty alert triggered for service=cb-serving, severity=high, symptom=latency spike + 5xx increase. Root ts=1755551111

samir: seeing a huge latency cliff on cb-serving in us-west-2. 95p token latency > 2s and queue depth slowly climbs. spikes started ~10m ago after a customer batch-run.

ana: can you confirm it's continuous batching path and not just model cold-start?

samir: tracing looks like requests are landing, getting queued, microbatch size grows to >128, kv-cache misses explode. evictions skyrocketing.

lin: kv cache eviction % jumped from 2% to 65% in 7m. looks like a cache blowup causing repeated page faults.

jules: customer reported degraded realtime responses in support. possible SLO impact for three orgs. Customer success alerted.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-175555 - cb-serving perf cliff. Pager assigned to samir.

samir: quick mitigation idea: temporarily disable continuous batching for public API routes in us-west-2 to force microbatch cap to 1 (serial) and avoid cache thrash. downside: p99 may increase slightly but should stop the cascading evictions.

ana: agree. can we do config rollout to disable cb for route /v1/generate for model=gpt-open-3?

lin: I can push a hotfix to route config. will shard rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. need under 5m.

jules: coordinate with CS: heads-up to impacted customers. ask them to throttle while we mitigate.

samir: also prepare fallback: route traffic to dedicated pool if disable cb doesn't recover. that pool has larger KV capacity.

lin: starting canary now. applying patch:
```json
{"route_overrides": {"/v1/generate": {"continuous_batching": false}}}
```

lin: canary at 10% applied. monitoring.

samir: telemetry: queue depth stopped growing at canary nodes, kv evictions stabilize. p95 dropped back to ~300ms.

ana: good. ramp to 50%.

lin: ramping to 50% now.

oncall-bot: Deployment event: route config update started by lin. 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

samir: during ramp we saw a microburst that still caused a small eviction spike on non-canary nodes. seems like the remaining cb-enabled nodes are still susceptible.

lin: 50% -> 100% done. full rollout complete.

samir: metrics now: kv eviction rate down to 4%, cpu on infer nodes normalized, p95 back in target.

jules: CS message drafted: "We're seeing a platform perf regression impacting real-time responses for a subset of customers. We've applied a config change to reduce batching on public routes in us-west-2 and are monitoring. Expect normal responses shortly." Want me to send now?

ana: yes send. include mitigation steps and ETA ~15m.

jules: sent. customer replies incoming: one asks whether this is a regression in model release.

samir: not a model release, looks like traffic pattern + cb heuristics interacting with kv eviction thresholds. we'll post full RCA later.

lin: root cause notes for postmortem: continuous-batching heuristics allowed microbatch to scale without backpressure when per-connection prefix reuse dropped; this increased working set in kv-cache -> eviction storm -> increased misses -> longer token compute -> more queueing -> feedback loop.

samir: short-term fixes: 1) cap microbatch size in cb to 64 by default, 2) add kv-cache usage circuit-breaker to temporarily force passes to non-cb path when eviction > 20% for X seconds, 3) improved telemetry to surface microbatch growth earlier.

ana: long-term: better cache-aware batching decisions, model-aware kernel selection to reduce footprint, and canary traffic shaping to avoid single-customer bursts.

jules: CS notes: two customers reported errors (400/503) during window. logged all request_ids and will follow up.

oncall-bot: Pager cleared by samir. Incident status: mitigation applied, monitoring.

samir: I'm going to cut a hotpatch PR with the microbatch cap + circuit-breaker config. linking in case y'all want to review: https://git.internal/r/redwood/cb/commit/ea1f2

lin: reviewed quick and approved. deploying hotpatch to prod tomorrow unless we want an immediate hotpatch.

ana: schedule immediate deploy to us-west-2 only, roll to others after validation. we need to avoid another slip in peak.

samir: I'll own rollout. Adding postmortem owners: samir (ops), lin (runtime), ana (SRE), jules (CS).

jules: I'll contact affected customers and offer credits where appropriate.

samir: thanks team. will keep thread updated with PR and postmortem link.

lin: adding logs excerpt from canary node:
```
[2026-03-15T12:34:22Z] cb: microbatch_size=128, kv_miss=0.62, eviction_rate=0.58
[2026-03-15T12:34:28Z] cb: microbatch_size=8, kv_miss=0.05, eviction_rate=0.03
[2026-03-15T12:35:10Z] route-update: continuous_batching=false applied -> recovery
```

samir: final note: if you see similar spike elsewhere, do immediate cb-disable for that region and page eng-oncall.

oncall-bot: Closing note: Incident INC-175555 mitigated at 1755552800. Postmortem placeholder created."
